page_title: STU 3-0 AUG | Stuttgart v Augsburg 20/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) makes a rough challenge and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul. Stuttgart are awarded the free kick.
90+1' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) squandered a huge opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He blazed it high over the bar.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
89' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to make a change. Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Chris Fuhrich.
86' Flag up against Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
82' Mads Pedersen goes off the pitch and Arne Maier (Augsburg) comes on.
81' Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
79' The resulting corner, taken by Arne Engels (Augsburg), comes to nothing.
79' The resulting corner from Arne Engels (Augsburg) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
78' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Deniz Undav and he is replaced by Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Silas (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Jamie Leweling.
75' The attendance for today's match is 53000.
73' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Pascal Stenzel.
73' Sebastian Hoeness decides to make a substitution. Dan-Axel Zagadou will be replaced by Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart).
71' Daniel Siebert shows the yellow card to Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) for a heavy challenge.
69' 3 - 0 Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and with a precise low drive puts the ball into the bottom right corner.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Phillip Tietz leaves the pitch and Dion Beljo (Augsburg) comes on.

67' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up inside the left post, but Alexander Nubel pulls off a comfortable save to thwart him.
65' Flag goes up against Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
62' Daniel Siebert shows a yellow card to Robert Gumny (Augsburg) for a tough tackle.
59' Substitution. Kevin Mbabu leaves the pitch and is replaced by Robert Gumny (Augsburg).
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) will replace Fredrik Jensen.
57' Arne Engels (Augsburg) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniel Siebert blows for a foul. Stuttgart win a free kick.
52' Dangerous play by Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart). Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul. Augsburg win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
49' Arne Engels (Augsburg) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

49' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Alexander Nubel makes a brilliant save! The ball is out of play. Augsburg will have a chance to score from a corner.
47' Patric Pfeiffer (Augsburg) commits a rough foul. Daniel Siebert stops the game and makes a call. Stuttgart will take a free kick.
46' Jess Thorup has made a change at the break. Patric Pfeiffer has come on in place of Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' 2 - 0 Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Finn Dahmen with a strike into the middle of the goal. He makes it 2:0.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) plays a through ball but overhits it.
41' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) commits a rough challenge and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul. Stuttgart have a free kick.
39' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
38' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick to Stuttgart.
37' A quickly taken corner by Stuttgart.
37' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Stuttgart earn a corner.
36' The corner kick from Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
32' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
30' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

28' Arne Engels (Augsburg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniel Siebert no option but to blow his whistle. Stuttgart earn a free kick.
24' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.

23' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniel Siebert has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Stuttgart will take a free kick near the side line.
21' The game is interrupted as Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) is flagged offside.
18' 1 - 0 Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) receives a cross from a well-taken corner kick and fires the ball into the top right corner via the post.
17' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is about to take a corner kick.
15' Daniel Siebert blows for a foul after Dan-Axel Zagadou (VfB Stuttgart) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Augsburg get a free kick.
13' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort smashes against the right post! What a shot that was!
11' Daniel Siebert shows a yellow card to Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

11' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
8' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Finn Dahmen stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.
7' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
6' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Augsburg force a corner. They send men into the box.
2' A clumsy foul by Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle. Stuttgart are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Augsburg will have the kick-off.
Daniel Siebert was nominated as the referee for this game.
